{{Quote|All red units, over here!|The unit commander, to all the units of Red Company|<ref name="Episode III" />}}
A '''clone trooper officer''' served as an [[Clone trooper officer|unit commander]]<ref name="HC 60" /> in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] as part of the [[41st Scout Battalion]] of the [[41st Elite Corps]]. The [[officer]] ordered all units of [[Red Company]] to relocate, and later participated in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]] towards the end of the war.<ref name="Episode III" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The clone trooper first appeared, albeit only by voice, in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']]. He was voiced by actor [[Temuera Morrison]].<ref name="Episode III" />
